name: SudokuPlus
summary:
A familiar puzzle. A hands-on experience.

SudokuPlus brings Sudoku into virtual space. Reach for a number, pinch to pick it up and place it on the board with Meta Quest hand tracking. An optional hand ray offers another way to interact.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
